title: 第十五章 皮肉骨血第十六章 猿臂蜂腰螳螂腿
content_zh:
“武道之基，共分为皮、肉、骨、血四关，想必你们这些都听过，照我说其实没那么复杂，就是一个最基本的‘炼’字。”
“炼？”
“对，炼，拼命炼，把力气炼大，炼得无穷大，常人擦着即伤，碰着即死就可以称为一代宗师了。”
梁渠跟在向长松身后，听到这话不免咧咧嘴。
肉身成圣是吧，可关键是怎么炼啊！
前世奥运会的顶级运动员告诉梁渠，人体是有极限的，没有特殊法门，绝不可能仅凭肉身就开碑裂石。
向长松下一句话证明了这点。
“当然，寻常人再怎么炼都有一个头，能十人敌就顶了天了。
想要突破这个极限，有两点离不开，法和药！”
“法和药？”
“没错，法就是法门，例如入我杨氏武馆就会发给你们练习的三拳法，有了法门人才有了向上的阶梯。”
梁渠问：“那药呢？”
向长松答道：“法铺就向上阶梯，可这阶梯陡！
险！
峻！
如此一来，你就需要扶手才能走得快，走得稳，不会掉下来摔得粉身碎骨，这就是药！”
“你们既从义兴市来，想必知道昨天义兴市的埠头上抓到两条宝鱼的消息吧？”
梁渠抱拳：“向师兄，实不相瞒，那两条宝鱼中便有一条牛角鲳是我捕到的，三斤多，卖了六两五钱，加上些积蓄，才攒够银钱来习武。”
向长松一愣，想到刚刚交付的七两，大抵就是那卖宝鱼得到的钱，笑道：“梁师弟倒是好运道。”
“那宝鱼，其实就是我们需要的药，一条宝鱼，几乎可以抵月余之功，此外还有宝肉，宝植，只要能帮助我们打熬气血，增进实力的，那都是药。”

“为此许多法门都有配套的药方，相辅相成，能起到一加一大于二的效果，例如我们的三拳法就有，别的法门吃了我们的药方，也有用，但效果就是不如练三拳法的好。”
“当然实在没法，多吃些肉也是可以的，多少能起到点作用。”
梁渠听得心思活泛。
宝肉自己没门路，可宝鱼和宝植他在行啊！
江淮泽野中的宝鱼不知凡几，肥鲶鱼几天就能找到两条宝鱼，长此以往，自己不是起飞？
倒是一旁的李立波有些沉默。
向长松注意到这点，并不奇怪，许多人以为进到武馆，就能有所成就，其实大错特错。
穷文富武，吃肉长大的孩子，就是比吃糠咽菜长大的要壮实。
两位师弟仅是寻常人家，怕是有些心灰意冷。
他也没出言打击，反而安慰道：“李师弟不必难过，没有药不代表武道之路就注定难走，事在人为，没有绝对的事情，世界上不凡有天才存在，不用药，一样可以走得又快又稳。”
“多谢向师兄，我记住了。”
向长松点点头，带着二人接着往里走：“所谓的皮肉骨血，就是武道前期的四个关卡，每破一关，都有不同的增益，同时也让我们更上一层楼。”
接下来在向长松的诉说下，梁渠对四关有了一个更深刻的理解。
简单说，皮关冲开，身无异状，可却皮似牛皮，韧而不破，防御大增。
肉关冲开，气力大增，单手提人不在话下。
骨关冲开，可以更加放肆的释放力量，做到真正的开碑裂石。
content_en:
"The foundation of martial arts is divided into four levels: skin, flesh, bone, and blood. You must have heard of these. According to me, it is not that complicated. It is just the most basic word 'refining'."
"Refining?"
"Yes, practice, practice hard, make your strength stronger, practice it to infinity, ordinary people will be injured if they are rubbed, and they will die if they are touched. Then you can be called a great master."
Liang Qu followed Xiang Changsong and grinned when he heard these words.
The physical body is sanctified, right? But the key is how to practice it!
The top athletes in the previous Olympic Games told Liang Qu that the human body has its limits. Without special methods, it is impossible to crack monuments and crack stones with just the physical body.
Xiang Changmatsu's next sentence proves this point.
"Of course, no matter how hard ordinary people practice, they still have a head, and being able to fight against ten people is as high as the sky.
If you want to break through this limit, two things are indispensable: law and medicine! "
"Dharma and medicine?"
"Yes, the method is the method. For example, when you enter my Yang Family Martial Arts School, you will be given three punches to practice. Only with the method can you move up the ladder."
Liang Qu asked: "Where is the medicine?"
Xiang Changsong replied: "The Dharma pavilion has an upward staircase, but this staircase is steep!
Danger!
Jun!
In this case, you need handrails to walk fast and steady without falling and being shattered into pieces. This is medicine! "
"Since you are from Yixing City, you must know the news that two treasure fish were caught at the port of Yixing City yesterday, right?"
Liang Qu clasped his fists: "Brother Xiang, to be honest, I caught one of the two treasure fish, a pomfret with more than three kilograms. I sold it for sixty-two and five cents. After adding some savings, I saved enough money to practice martial arts."
Xiang Changsong was stunned, thinking that the seven taels he had just delivered were probably the money he got from selling the treasure fish, and smiled: "Junior Brother Liang is really lucky."
"That treasure fish is actually the medicine we need. A treasure fish can almost last more than a month. In addition, there are treasure meat and treasure plants. Anything that can help us with our energy and blood and increase our strength is medicine."
"For this reason, many methods have matching prescriptions that complement each other and can achieve the effect of one plus one greater than two. For example, our three-punch method has it. Other methods that take our prescription are also effective, but the effect is not as good as practicing the three-punch method."
"Of course there's really nothing we can do. It's okay to eat more meat. It will have some effect."
Liang Qu felt very excited after hearing this.
Baorou has no way of doing it himself, but he is good at Baoyu and Baozhi!
There are countless treasure fish in the wilds of Jianghuai River. Fat catfish can find two treasure fish in a few days. If things go on like this, won't they take off?
On the other hand, Li Libo on the side was a little silent.
It's not surprising that Xiang Changsong noticed this. Many people think that they can achieve something by entering a martial arts gym. In fact, they are completely wrong.
Poor in culture and rich in martial arts, children who grow up eating meat are stronger than those who grow up eating bran-thick vegetables.
The two junior brothers are just ordinary people, I am afraid they are a little frustrated.
He did not say anything to attack him, but comforted him: "Junior brother Li, don't be sad. Without medicine, it does not mean that the road to martial arts is destined to be difficult. Everything depends on man-made things. There are no absolutes. There are extraordinary geniuses in the world. Without medicine, you can still walk fast and steadily."
"Thank you, Senior Brother Xiang, I will remember it."
Xiang Changsong nodded and led the two of them inside: "The so-called skin, flesh, and blood are the four levels in the early stage of martial arts. Each level passed has different benefits, and it also allows us to move to the next level."
After talking to Changsong, Liang Qu had a deeper understanding of the four passes.
To put it simply, once the skin barrier is opened, there will be no abnormality on the body, but the skin will be like cowhide, tough but not broken, and the defense will be greatly increased.
The flesh barrier is opened, the strength is greatly increased, and it is easy to lift people with one hand.
By breaking open the bone barrier, you can release your power more freely and truly crack open monuments and rocks.
